label: nx_gbasoft_help_010
text:
This right here is the screen where you can connect to
Game Boy Advance games! If you want to transfer Pokémon
you caught in Game Boy Advance games to Pokémon HOME,
here’s where to do it!

label: nx_gbasoft_help_020
text:
You’ll need to pick which Box you want to transfer over. Then all
the Pokémon in that Box will be sent to Pokémon HOME! Isn’t
that something?

label: nx_gbasoft_help_030
text:
The Pokémon sent over will be dropped into your Pokémon HOME
Boxes in the order that they arrive wherever there’s space!

label: nx_gbasoft_help_040
text:
Just watch out, because that means that sometimes they end up in
different Boxes from each other!
